items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: It was Jack Johnson's nightclub... We used to come around and stare at it and look at it until he would come out and get in it.

ctx.x: And my uncle had this thing where he could walk in the gutter, you know, in the business section or something, walk around and pick up money. He'd walk in the street and see money, and I'd be right behind him, and I didn't see nothing! Ain't that somethin'?
And we walked to 40...34th and...some street which had a nightclub. It was Jack Johnson's nightclub. And he used to put out (?) gold spittoons.
